entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The dark lower levels of the City of Ravnica beneath the Tenth District, a labyrinth of ruins, tunnels and communities that shelters outcasts and guilds.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane built ever upward over countless generations.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: The district of Ravnica above which the Undercity sprawls.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild whose spies move through the Undercity and whose guildhall is Duskmantle.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The decay-harvesting guild whose guildhall is Korozda, with kraul and Erstwhile allies.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The riotous guild whose stronghold is Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The mutagenic guild whose researchers use the flooded depths and zonots.

entities.name: Duskmantle
entities.description: The secretive guildhall of House Dimir, protected by memory wards.

entities.name: Nightveil
entities.description: A network of caves beneath the Tenth District where high-ranking Dimir operatives keep hidden estates.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: The underground guildhall of the Golgari Swarm.

entities.name: Svogthos
entities.description: The Golgari's former guildhall, an ancient Orzhov cathedral, once the lair of the lich parun Svogthir.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: A lich parun who reigned from Svogthos.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The cavernous stronghold of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon lord of the Cult of Rakdos who takes displeasing cultists to the Jester's Crypt.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon whose victims' statues fill the Statuary; character is also a planeswalker.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: A Phyrexian tree whose spreading branches tore sections of the Undercity open and thrust them skyward.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Undercity was torn open.

entities.name: Risen Undercity
entities.description: The sections of the Undercity raised to the surface and exposed to sunlight.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, sections of the Undercity are torn open and thrust skyward by the Invasion Tree's branches, exposing buried terrain to sunlight.
events.quote: massive sections of its hidden tunnels and ruins were torn open and thrust skyward by the spreading branches of the Invasion Tree

events.summary: Exposure to sunlight gives rise to new species and plant mutations in the Risen Undercity, studied by botanists and Simic researchers.
events.quote: This so-called Risen Undercity gave rise to new species and unusual plant mutations

relations.quote: These shadowy depths sprawl beneath the streets and towers of the Tenth District
The secretive guildhall of House Dimir lies hidden somewhere in the Undercity.
the sprawling underground guildhall of the Golgari Swarm
The cavernous stronghold of the Cult of Rakdos
